WITH filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
),
filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_current_price 
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
),
filtered_catalog_sales AS (
    SELECT cs_warehouse_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_item_sk, cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0) as adjusted_sales_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)
    INNER JOIN filtered_date ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
filtered_catalog_returns AS (
    SELECT cr_warehouse_sk, cr_returned_date_sk, cr_item_sk, adjusted_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0) as adjusted_return_price
    FROM catalog_returns
    INNER JOIN filtered_date ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
joined AS (
    SELECT w_state, i_item_id, SUM(adjusted_sales_price) as sales_before, SUM(adjusted_return_price) as sales_after
    FROM filtered_catalog_sales
    LEFT JOIN filtered_catalog_returns ON (cs_warehouse_sk = cr_warehouse_sk AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)
    INNER JOIN warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
    GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
),
final AS (
    SELECT * FROM joined WHERE sales_before > 0 AND sales_after > 0
)
SELECT * FROM final ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id LIMIT 100
